name: Kagoshima

flag.description: A black horseshoe around a red disc on a white field: a map of the prefecture around Sakurajima.
flag.symbolism: The black ring is the Satsuma and Ōsumi peninsulas, with a dent for Shibushi Bay, and the red disc is the volcano Sakurajima.

hook: Kagoshima's black horseshoe holds a red ball: two peninsulas hugging the Sakurajima volcano.
trivia: Sakurajima, facing the capital across the bay, is one of Japan's most active volcanoes.
The flag is now rarely flown: its map leaves out the prefecture's many islands, and a separate symbol flag is used instead.
